messages:
alex: Starting stepwise enable for nova-13b-v2 in the model catalog. Change window tonight 18:00-20:00 PT. Plan: pin traffic 2% -> 10% -> 50% over ~30m intervals with metrics checkpoint at each step. Calling for ops ack and fallback ordering confirmation.

maria: Ack from infra side. Quick Q: what's the fallback priority? quant-v2 fallback to fp16 or to older 13b?

alex: Fallback ladder: 1) nova-13b-v2-quant (same variant) 2) nova-13b-v2-fp16 (if quant saturates) 3) nova-13b-legacy-13b (final). We want latency-first but preserve quality.

sam: Put the rollback triggers in the runbook please — recommend rollback if p95 latency increases > 150ms over baseline OR error rate > 0.8% for 5m.

priya: +1 to Sam's thresholds. Also add token-cost spike alert: >30% token cost delta should pause rollout.

alex: Good call. I'll update the checklist. Will also include strict canary circuit: if any step hits a trigger we immediately revert to pinned version and notify oncall.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled catalog enable for nova-13b-v2 at 2024-04-10T18:00:00-07:00. Stages: 2%, 10%, 50%. Notifying channels: #eng-releases, #eng-oncall. Use `deploybot status $thread` to watch.

maria: One more question — do we warm KV cache / prefixes before increasing to 50%?

alex: Yes — warm step between 10% and 50% for 10 minutes using small synthetic traffic + production-sampled prefixes. Script in repo: `tools/warm_prefixes.sh --model nova-13b-v2 --duration 10m`.

priya: Re: observability, can we gate by sample-based quality checks? If rouge/bertscore drops > 3% on seeded promptset then pause.

sam: Add that as a safety gate. We'll fetch the seedset from /evals/cutover/nova13b.

alex: Updated runbook snippets: ```
# pin command
curl -X POST "https://catalog.redwood.internal/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"nova-13b-v2","percent":10,"reason":"staged-enable-1705556666"}'
```

alex: And rollback command: ```
curl -X POST "https://catalog.redwood.internal/unpin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"nova-13b-v2","reason":"rollback-triggered"}'
```

deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks passed (quota, slot allocation, telemetry hooks). Canary window set to 10m per stage.

eng-oncall: I'll be oncall during the window (pager enabled). If a rollback happens, I will run the unpin and confirm on this thread.

maria: +1 from me. Also I'll run the perf dashboards and check region tilt.

priya: +1. I uploaded the seed prompts and quality dashboards here: https://internal.redwood/evals/nova13b-cutover

sam: Approved. I'll watch autoscaler and batch queues. If we see sustained queue growth > 20% we throttle the next step.

alex: Thanks everyone. Final decision: proceed with stepwise enable at 18:00 PT. Rollback criteria: p95 latency +150ms, error rate >0.8% for 5m, quality drop >3% on seedset, token-cost +30%. eng-oncall will execute rollback. Notifying product and CS for telemetry.

priya: :thumbsup: good luck, will monitor quality.

maria: :rocket:

deploybot: deploybot: enable operation queued. See logs at https://deploys.redwood/internal/1705556666-nova13b-enable

alex: I'll post a short release note after first stage. If anything odd, tag me @alex and call the rollback.
